notes: Partial: Conjecture 2 (first 2^m at nextprime(2^m)) holds for m iff no almost perfect k (sigma(k) = 2k-1) other than a power of 2 has nextprime(2^m) <= 2k-1, k < 2^m; such a k would also break Conjecture 1. No such k below 2e7, so Conjecture 2 holds for m <= 24. Lean main theorem A215926_at_prime (a(p) for primes 2^m < p < 2^(m+1)). Outside Lean: a(n) <= max(3, 2^(m-1)) for n < nextprime(2^m) (hand proof), Bertrand, sigma sieve to 2e7. Both conjectures stay open (they need the almost perfect number problem).

prior_art.note: Reduction to almost perfect numbers not found elsewhere.
